criteria.required: Read-only player_baseline and team_baseline use explicit source/save/season/cutoff scope and per-field provenance/staleness, fail closed on scope/identity mismatch.

Knowledge and coverage correctly classify missing/stale/conflicting/withheld sources, badges held vs native eligibility, and never upgrade unbound archive/MyPLAYER research to verified 2K22 game facts.

Player and fixed-roster diagnosis use compatible capture Scope and database/source identities; role assumptions and relative-rating conversions remain labeled hypotheses/unverified observations; partial PlayType absence cannot cause negative proof.

Native/REA plan compiler only maps candidate actions against pinned catalog and exact historical evidence scope; no fresh Getter authentication is claimed and all plans remain NEEDS_VALIDATION or FORBIDDEN, execute=false.
Offline synthetic 2x2 main/interaction effect arithmetic and confounders/missing-cells negative cases are correct and labeled synthetic, while real game causality remains NOT_CAUSALLY_IDENTIFIED.

Deterministic CLI and BIC integration offline fixtures execute with non-mutating source checks and historical query_at isolation, and report real source build/save unknown without inventing provenance.

Reviewed offline source integrity, test-source SHA256, recorded regression/CLI exit codes, reproducible Git checkpoints and retained failure attempts are traceable; no protected master, native/save write or game process access.
